summary: The TimetableAssessments class manages assessment schedules and functionalities related to timetabled assessments.
purpose: To facilitate the handling and scheduling of assessments within timetables, including managing assessor and subject configurations.

workflows.name: Assessment Management
steps: Bind data to master grid and handle events for adding and editing assessments.

validations: Validates dates and ensures mandatory fields are filled.
calculations: Calculate open and close days based on assessment type.
dependencies: User session for context and data retrieval.
